objects.taxonomy_description: Fabric bag with two parallel shoulder straps for carrying on the back. The main compartment is a rectangular or rounded pouch (30-55 cm tall) made of nylon, canvas, or polyester with a zipper or drawstring closure. External features include side pockets, front organizer pockets, and compression straps. The back panel has padded shoulder straps that converge at the top and a reinforced grab handle. Materials range from smooth synthetic fabric to textured canvas. Colors vary widely. The bag exhibits bilateral symmetry with straps positioned symmetrically on the back panel.

objects.taxonomy_description: Adult male bird exhibiting pronounced sexual dimorphism from female. Body is compact and robust measuring 30-70 cm in length depending on species. Plumage is characterized by vivid, iridescent coloration with metallic green, blue, purple, or copper tones on the neck, breast, and tail feathers. Hackle feathers (neck plumage) are elongated, pointed, and glossy, forming a distinctive ruff around the neck. Saddle feathers (lower back) are elongated and flowing. Tail feathers are long, curved, and iridescent with a characteristic arching posture. Comb is a fleshy, serrated crest on the crown, bright red and vascularized; size and shape vary by breed. Wattles are paired fleshy appendages hanging from the lower beak, also bright red. Beak is short, curved, and keratinous with a yellow to grey coloration. Legs are stout with thick, scaled skin and a prominent posterior spur (calcified projection) on the tarsus used in combat. Feet are anisodactyl (three toes forward, one backward) with sharp, curved claws. The bird exhibits an upright, alert posture with chest puffed and tail elevated.

objects.taxonomy_description: Large gregarious predatory feline of Africa and India with a distinctive tawny coat. Males have a prominent shaggy mane ranging from blonde to dark brown surrounding the head and neck. Coat is short, dense, and uniform tawny with a lighter underside. Body is large, muscular, and well-proportioned with powerful legs and a long tail with a dark tuft at the end. Head is broad with a short muzzle. Ears are small, rounded, and erect. Eyes are medium-sized, round, and amber to brown with an intense expression. The breed's signature features include the male's distinctive mane, social pride behavior, and tawny coat with tail tuft.
